channel.title: Rugspull Evidence Updates
channel.description: Dated, risk-first Rugspull evidence and operating-gate updates. Not live analytics, investment advice, an audit, or a safety signal.

item.title: What does Founder Token immobility mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to protocol-held Founder Allocation custody, the distinction between fungible RugToken and allocation provenance, unlock behavior, the direct-to-pool one-shot sale, invariant scope, and evidence limits.

item.title: Office Counter report 015 — 2026-07-19
item.description: Search Console accepted the 48-URL sitemap and reports 48 discovered pages. The new reserve-reconciliation guide is not indexed because Google cannot recognize the URL and has no referring sitemap; a priority indexing request was initiated. IndexNow accepted 59 URLs. Discovery and request activity do not prove indexing, ranking, clicks, approval, audit, adoption, or endorsement.

item.title: What does reserve reconciliation mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to canonical RugPool stored reserves, actual token and WBNB balances, buy and sell bookkeeping, atomic rollback, invariant scope, direct-transfer surplus, and evidence limits.

item.title: What does no double rug mean?

item.title: What does no double claim mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to aggregate wallet entitlements, mutually exclusive successful and Failed claim paths, checks-effects-interactions, atomic rollback, Creator stake separation, invariant scope, and the difference between one-shot and fully settled.

item.title: What does WBNB conservation mean?

item.title: What does token conservation mean?

item.title: What are smart contract invariants?

item.title: What are alternative pools on BNB Chain?

item.title: Why is Cloudflare D1 not financial truth?
